tier1.headline: Your data crosses borders.
tier1.quote: Gandi may transfer your personal data outside the European Union, to countries that do not ensure an adequate level of protection of personal data.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI.
tier1.quote: Data transfers may also take place within the framework of the aforementioned purposes in connection with service providers (for example: recruitment, fight against fraud, statistical analyses, data aggregation, Zendesk Chat module, etc.).

tier1.headline: Your data collected from others.
tier1.quote: Third parties, in particular in the context of the contractual relationship with our customers or resellers, or in the context of incoming transfers of domain names from other registrars;

tier2.headline: Your data shared internally.
tier2.quote: In this Privacy Policy, "Gandi" refers to the companies of Gandi group as a whole, all of these entities being subject to the same level of data protection.

tier2.headline: Your data kept as long as needed.
tier2.quote: Personal data are kept in accordance with legal and tax provisions for a period that does not exceed that which is necessary for the purposes for which data were collected and processed.

tier2.headline: Your profile is built.
tier2.quote: To carry out statistical analysis for profiling and segmentation purposes for targeted marketing, audience measurement and performance measurement;

tier2.headline: Your ads are targeted.
tier2.quote: Through these cookies, this third party will also collect and use your browsing data on its own behalf to provide targeted advertising and content based on your browsing history.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with authorities.
tier2.quote: Gandi may also transfer your data to third parties, if this is required by legal or regulatory provisions or in the context of legitimate requests from third parties (for example: respect of intellectual property rights, etc.).
